title.narrative: With UNICEF support;1,787,814 young people (894,053 girls and 893,761 boys) were equipped with socio-emotional, green, advocacy, entrepreneurship, and other transferable skills. Through the partnership with MoPSE, UNICEF integrated socio-emotional skills development into the school programme for 7-9 grades.;In collaboration with MoPSE and Zamin Foundation, UNICEF established a national network Young Climate Champions. During the last three months the adolescents increased climate change awareness and mobilized over 6,400 peers in communities gaining support from school administration, Ministry of Ecology and local government.;
